question: Differences 52 and 53: predictions for an open section panel while the frame scrolls, at two section heights and one other frame not read before, pushed before any read.
from: CAP-U9SCROLL.json and CAP-U9SCROLL2.json, one section at height 623.7, frame 945: band on top plus scroll 771 to 824, opened at 801 (top 213, scroll 588), closed with the bottom at 118 to 98. CAP-VIEWLAYOUTS.json has panels opening outside +48.4 to +101.4 from the section top, so a band fixed to the section top seems wrong.

rule.band: Inferred. On top plus scroll the panel holds inside a band 53 wide, 30 below and 23 above where it opened. Past an edge it goes 1:1 with the page.
rule.holds: Inferred. Top never below 0, nor above window - 477.
rule.closes: Inferred. It closes when the section's bottom in the window passes 108, at any height and frame, and stays closed scrolling back. Not claimed as the rule for 44: growing a section doesn't move its bottom up.

hit.band edge: within 6 px, read in steps of 5
hit.holds at bottom: within 2 px, or not reached, which counts as not tested
hit.closes: the last open and first closed reads, in steps of 20, hold a bottom within 10 of 108
hit.scrolling back: closed for all of 20 steps back

Custom 50, window 1000.band low: top at opening + scroll at opening - 30
Custom 50, window 1000.band high: top at opening + scroll at opening + 23
Custom 50, window 1000.closes: section's bottom in the window at 108, within 10

Custom 150, window 1000.band low: top at opening + scroll at opening - 30
Custom 150, window 1000.band high: top at opening + scroll at opening + 23
Custom 150, window 1000.closes: section's bottom in the window at 108, within 10

default height, window 1200.band low: top at opening + scroll at opening - 30
default height, window 1200.band high: top at opening + scroll at opening + 23
default height, window 1200.closes: section's bottom in the window at 108, within 10
